#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <regex>
#include <algorithm>
#include <sstream>

using namespace std;

int longestWords(const string& line) {
    int best = 0;
    stringstream ss(line);
    string word;
    while (getline(ss, word, '_')) {
        best = max(best, (int)word.length());
    }
    return best;
}

long long countInside(const string& inner) {
    long long count = 0;
    stringstream ss(inner);
    string part;
    while (getline(ss, part, '_')) {
        if (!part.empty()) {
            count++;
        }
    }
    return count;
}

int main() {
    int n;
    string s;
    cin >> n >> s;

    regex pattern(R"(\([\w_]*\))");
    // Split outside parentheses
    sregex_token_iterator outsideIter(s.begin(), s.end(), pattern, -1);
    sregex_token_iterator end;
    int longest = 0;
    for (; outsideIter != end; ++outsideIter) {
        longest = max(longest, longestWords(*outsideIter));
    }

    // Count inside parentheses
    long long inside = 0;
    sregex_iterator matchIter(s.begin(), s.end(), pattern);
    sregex_iterator matchEnd;
    for (; matchIter != matchEnd; ++matchIter) {
        string matched = matchIter->str();
        string inner = matched.substr(1, matched.length() - 2);
        inside += countInside(inner);
    }

    cout << longest << " " << inside << endl;
    return 0;
}
